name: JFNetworker
text: A network simulator and lab with a topology editor, device consoles and a step-by-step simulation mode.
alt: JFNetworker with a campus network of a switch, a router, a server and four PCs on a grid.

name: BackupCraft
text: A backup suite with deduplicated, encrypted, signed backups, schedules and roles, and its own server and agents.
alt: BackupCraft's list of backup jobs with status badges and a navigation pane, with demo data.

name: jfWord
text: A word processor with a ribbon, page view, text styles, tables, references and DOCX support.
alt: jfWord with its ribbon, a navigation pane and a document.

name: PaintCraft
text: An image editor with layers, history, effects, many image formats and native plugins.
alt: PaintCraft with the JFLib sample drawing open.

name: Kritzel
text: A drawing app with brushes, shapes, text, selections and layers.
alt: Kritzel with the JFLib sample drawing.

name: Build Manager
text: A graphical build app for applications, styles, profiles, tests and release packages.
alt: The Build Manager with an app list and build settings.
